business_problem: Eaton needed to manage thousands of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and improve data access across teams, prompting the company to find a solution to streamline operations, automate documentation, and support knowledge transfer.
solution_summary: Eaton used Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 to turn complex business content into faster digital workflows. Eaton needed to manage thousands of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and improve data access across teams, prompting the company to find a solution to streamline operations, automate documentation, and support knowledge transfer. Key implementation elements included Microsoft 365 Copilot applies AI to documents, meetings, mail, and other everyday knowledge work; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Microsoft 365 provides the documents, messages, and meetings that feed user workflows. Business documents and enterprise content are ingested into the AI workflow, classified or summarized by the model layer, and routed into the application or operations process where employees can review and act on the output. business_outcome: Eaton adopted Microsoft 365 Copilot to automate the creation of 1,000 SOPs, streamline customer service operations, and improve data access. Eaton’s Copilot adoption cut SOP creation time from one hour to 10 minutes, improved data access, and is expected to cut customer response times by 20%, simplifying knowledge transfer and freeing employees to focus on higher-value tasks.
